summary: Curate matches whole words through an external-content FTS5 table lancet_works_fts(title, topic) with the porter unicode61 tokenizer, kept in sync by triggers and built once on open for older databases. Each query word is quoted and all must match.
reason: The LIKE '%phrase%' filter matched inside words, so a short query hit unrelated works (ai in air, badge in badger), and a two-word query matched only the exact phrase. User text is quoted per token so it can never be read as FTS syntax. A failed index build is an error, never a silent return to LIKE.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/lancet/ covers whole-word and multi-word matching, case, hostile input, trigger sync and backfill. On a real Lancet mirror, precision of the top 20 for ai went from 0 to 20; four processes opening an unindexed copy at once all succeeded.
